name: Wire Machine Systems

about:
Wire Machine Systems was founded in 1987 in Fort Wayne, Indiana. The company entered the market as a supplier of equipment and services to the wire, cable, bar, and tube industries, positioning itself as a one-stop shop for machinery, spare parts, and technical support.

The firm provides state-of-the-art manufacturing equipment — including drawbenches, roll pointers, shot blasting systems, buncher bows, wire straighteners, and spring coiling machines — along with spare parts for European and Asian machinery. A centralized warehouse in Fort Wayne stocks replacement components for a wide range of equipment, allowing the company to ship parts quickly even for machines it did not originally supply. Technical support and application engineering round out the service offering.

Wire Machine Systems serves manufacturers in the wire, cable, bar, and tube sectors, as well as spring producers in automotive, appliance, and industrial markets. Its equipment handles ferrous and non-ferrous materials, and the spare-parts program supports customers across any industry that runs wire, rod, bar, or tube processing lines.

The company emphasizes its 50-plus years of combined industry experience, a one-stop-shop model that bundles equipment sales, spare parts, and dedicated support, and a commitment to rapid response and fair pricing. The Fort Wayne location is described as centrally situated for national and international distribution.
